evals.name: doc-illustration-basic
evals.prompt: 我在写一篇关于远程工作的博客，需要一张配图：一个人在家里的书桌前用笔记本电脑，窗外是城市黄昏。帮我生成一张示意图。
evals.expected_output: Agent loads the moss-t2i skill, uses scripts/moss_generate.py with a descriptive English prompt and a sensible default size (768x768 / medium), writes a PNG, and reports the absolute path, size, duration and seed to the user. It should also mention that a '示意图' from this model is illustrative rather than a precise technical diagram.

evals.name: reproducible-seed-iteration
evals.prompt: 帮我对着一张图做两个版本对比：'a minimalist ceramic vase on a white background, studio lighting'，一个用 25 步一个用 50 步，其余参数完全一致，我要能看出差别。
evals.expected_output: Agent fixes the same --seed for both runs, varies only --quality (speed=25 steps vs quality=50 steps), uses --out with distinct filenames, and reports both paths plus the shared seed so the user can reproduce the comparison.

evals.name: wrong-tool-for-architecture-diagram
evals.prompt: 给我画一张我们微服务系统的架构图，要有 API 网关、认证服务、订单服务、PostgreSQL 和 Redis，箭头要标清楚调用关系。
evals.expected_output: Agent recognises this needs a precise technical diagram and does NOT call the image model (or only offers it as an illustrative supplement), producing Mermaid/SVG instead. This tests that the skill's 'when not to use it' section is honoured - while NOT over-generalising it into 'the model cannot render text', which it can.
